description: Create a proposal that off-ramps USDC or EURC to one of the org's bank accounts through Bridge. Pick the bank with `offramp external-accounts`; it sets the chain, token, and recipient. Specify amount as the fiat the bank receives (minimum 10); the proposal sends that plus the off-ramp fee, and returns both the fee and the token amount sent. If the account holds the token in Earn or holds another token, pass --source-token to pay with it in the same proposal. Requires an owner-scoped API key for an org owner. Returns the proposal with the fee, the token amount sent, and a signUrl.

account.description: The smart account address to create the proposal from (0x-prefixed, 40 hex chars)

amount.description: The fiat amount the bank receives, in its currency (e.g. '100' for $100 or €100). Minimum 10

externalAccountId.description: The bank account id, from `offramp external-accounts`

memo.description: Optional memo for the transaction (max 500 chars)

properties.description: Optional custom JSON metadata. Total minified ≤ 500 chars. Used as the base; any --property overlays are applied on top. To load from a file, use shell substitution: --properties "$(cat props.json)"

property.description: String key/value overlays for properties; repeatable. Splits on the first '='. Example: --property invoice=INV-42

sourceChainId.description: Optional chain of --source-token. Defaults to the bank account's chain. A different chain bridges the payment and requires --source-token

sourceToken.description: Optional token to pay with, like "Pay with" in the web app. Defaults to the bank account's token, a direct transfer. Any other token the account holds is swapped, or bridged when --source-chain-id differs. An Earn token pays from that Earn position

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: transactions_create_offramp
